message.jaymoskingdoms.retaking.paid_rea: The story pays: %s, and %s hears of it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaking.warriorb: The dust goes quiet when you step into it, as if it knew the weight of your boots.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaking.frostbor: Under the hum of it you hear a word your grandmother used to sing. It sounds like "home".
retaking.tell.keeper.story.open: Everyone who climbs up here has a story, and tells it as though it were a small one. It never is.
retaking.tell.keeper.story.said: That is how it begins for most. Mind the wind on the way down.
retaking.tell.keeper.giant.open: A breath I have held a very long time went out of me just now. Do not ask what it was holding. I would have to start from before the towns.
retaking.tell.keeper.giant.said: Something that was asleep. The highlands each left one. I thought I would be gone before any of them was woken.
retaking.tell.keeper.star.open: The lights come down. They have always come down. All that ever changes is who is standing under them.
retaking.tell.keeper.star.ask: Who is standing under them now?
retaking.tell.keeper.star.said: You. And whoever you bring. It is a better crowd than I had the last time.
retaking.tell.keeper.spirit.open: Something woke for you, and you carry it kindly. Five of them stood in one place once. Four are about. The fifth never had much to say.
retaking.tell.keeper.spirit.said: Ask yours who stood beside it. It may answer. It may only look at you, which is more.
retaking.tell.keeper.dragon.open: On a dark night there is a light in a wood far below. It has not been lit in longer than I have been counting. Keep it burning.
retaking.tell.keeper.dragon.ask: What happens if it goes out?
retaking.tell.keeper.dragon.said: Then the wood is dark again, and the ford is only a ford.
retaking.tell.judge.rank.open: A job done well, or done badly, goes in the book like everything else. It is not what you were paid. It is what you did while you were being paid.
retaking.tell.judge.rank.said: Everyone's is. I do not read the length.
retaking.tell.judge.stones.open: The old stones keep a book of their own. Mine is the shorter.
retaking.tell.judge.stones.said: Where people stood, and when. It adds up to something in the end. It always does.
retaking.tell.judge.raiders.open: Those who raid and those who are raided come to me by the same road. The weight differs. The road does not.
retaking.tell.judge.raiders.ask: And the ones who come down from the sky?
retaking.tell.judge.raiders.said: They have been in my book longer than your towns have.
retaking.tell.judge.weighed.open: Now you know how your page reads. Whether it pleases you is no business of mine. I read it fairly.
retaking.tell.judge.weighed.said: Every day. It is the only reason I go on reading.
retaking.tell.judge.wither.open: There is a count kept lower down than mine. It is not a fair book. I would rather it ended before mine does.
retaking.tell.judge.wither.said: Someone who wants the numbers and not the weight. Go carefully.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.goblin.open: You put down a small king. In my day we would have given a great deal for a world with only small ones.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.goblin.said: Bigger. You will see. Not yet.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.ogre.open: Your stones. We had stones too, in the old streets. We did not know what they were for either.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.ogre.said: To be seen from far off, by someone who wanted to know where the rest of us were.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.maw.open: A dust that hums. We do not go near it. We learned that from the ones who did.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.maw.said: A whole world's worth of people, somewhere in the dust. It did not go quietly.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.bane.open: What you bury does not always stay down. We buried a great deal. We are still being handed it back.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.bane.ask: Did you ever finish with any of it?
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.bane.said: Once. It took everything we had, and it was back the next morning with a new face.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.dragon.open: Whatever you do at that ford, do it where it will be seen. Things that happen nowhere do not get written down.
retaking.tell.omen_pilot.dragon.said: By anyone who comes after. Even the dead keep a record, if you give them something to keep.
retaking.tell.tinkerer.biobuilt.open: Hm. You. Stand there. No, there, in the cold part. Funny. I left the stove lit, and the benches always feel colder with one of mine in the room.
retaking.tell.tinkerer.biobuilt.said: Nothing! Nothing at all. You are exactly what you are. Not finished, but exactly that.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.retaking.0: A small king, and a smaller crown. Well done, little one. Mind the cut on your hand.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.retaking.1: A big king, this time. I had to look away. Not because of him. Because of how you stood.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.retaking.2: His laugh is out of the world now, little one. The bones will be quieter for a while. So will I, I think.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.retaking.3: I knew the way down once. I would rather you did not ask me which turn.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.retaking.4: That was a hard one. Sit a moment. I will keep watch, as I have before.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.retaking.0: A goblin. A goblin! Four hundred years of study, and I spend it watching somebody hit one. Well done, I suppose.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.retaking.1: Large. Loud. Dead. Fine. Can we stop standing in the open now?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.retaking.2: He laughs, does he? I knew a man who laughed like that. He is not in my confidence any more.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.retaking.3: Down there nothing is lit that did not mean to be. Keep your elbows in.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.retaking.4: Don't look at me like that. I am not fond of you. I am simply not leaving.
One king down, dear. It is traditional to write it up. I have started on the second paragraph.
Ogres, you see, are not stupid. They are only patient about it. Do remember that.
I have a note on his laugh somewhere. Nobody asked me for it at the time. Dear me.
Everything below keeps a ledger, dear. I do not care for what it says about the reader.
Do put the book down for a moment. You are allowed a moment. I am only a little cross.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.retaking.0: First of the line. Good. The rest will not go down as easy.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.retaking.1: I had orcs under me once. Leagues of them. Not one of them was that big. Not one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.retaking.2: He holds the dead like a bad general holds a bridge. He will lose it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.retaking.3: Hold the line. Whatever is under it, hold the line.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.retaking.4: Three nights, once. I remember every one. If it comes to it again, I will stand where I stood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_priest: You swore at a shrine. I felt it from here, the way you feel a door shut in another room.
Is that bad?
No. It is only noticed.
Do the patrons listen?
Some nights I would swear to it. Most nights I would swear it is only me.
The old stones are older than any of the seven. The seven do not like to be reminded.
Older than the patrons?
So the oldest prayers say, if you read them backwards.
Then who raised them?
Someone who wanted to be found, I would say.
A star fell and you walked up to it. Faith would have me call that a sign. I will say you have good boots.
Was it a sign?
Of what, I have not decided. Of something.
Just boots.
The best kind of piety, some days.
You have been down where the demons keep their houses. Do not tell the others at the shrine. Tell me, if you like.
It was quiet.
That is what the old rite says it is. A quiet place with a very long list.
I would rather not.
Quite right.
There is a light in the old wood. I saw it from the bell tower. I rang nothing. I only stood there.
Why?
It seemed rude to disturb it.
It is only a lantern.
Is it? Then it is the best-kept lantern in the world.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_truth_: You have read that old book. The Truth has no use for a book with a hole in the middle. Five stood: write them down properly, or do not write it.
Maybe the hole is the point.
Then it is a poor point, and a poorer book.
Which five?
That is the whole complaint. The Truth wants names.
Stones standing in fields are not a faith. They are a surveying error.
Someone raised them.
Then someone should be asked to explain. In writing.
Have you stood before one?
I have no need.
I know what you swore to. I am not here to be rude. I am here to be correct. Your patrons are painted faces, and I can show you the paint.
Show me.
The seven are stories told to children who needed their fathers to be bigger. A book needs no father.
They answered me.
Something answered. Something always answers. That is not a proof. That is a draught.
They say the Judge keeps a book. The Truth keeps a book. I would like the two compared by someone with no stake.
I could do it.
You have a stake. You have a page.
Let them be.
That has never settled an argument.
A light in an old keep. The Truth has no opinion on lights. I find I have a strong feeling about this one.
What feeling?
That if it is lit, it should be seen to.
Light it, then.
I did. Do not mention it to the bishop.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_wizard: A king of goblins, and not a spell cast. Excellent. Wizards will tell you it takes magic. It takes a stick, and not minding.
A good stick?
Any stick. It is the not minding that is rare.
It took more than that.
It always does. Write it down while you remember.
I took a reading at the stone outside town. The needle went round and round and round. I have not been so happy since I was an apprentice.
What does that mean?
That it is doing something. Nobody can say what. That is the best kind of stone.
It is only a rock.
Then it is a rock that makes a needle spin. Go on, call it a rock again.
You have been up where the air is thin and tastes of old copper. I envy you, and I will deny it if asked.
It was beautiful.
I thought so. Write it down. No, do not. Tell me instead.
It was cold.
Of course it was. The good places usually are.
Anything that falls out of the sky arrives with its own weather. Pin that to your sleeve.
What kind of weather?
The kind that is not from here. It hums at the edges.
It was only a rock.
They always are, right up until they are not.
You have met the dark that answers back. The books say do not answer. Did you answer?
Only once.
Once is how it starts. Keep your voice for the living.
No.
Good. Then you are better at this than most of the court.
You ask why Death and Blood are forbidden. Every court forbids them and not one of us can say why. I was told it was because they work. That was the whole answer.
What happened when someone tried?
A court was emptied. Not killed. Emptied. The ones who lived did not know their own names for a season.
Then I should leave them be.
Everyone says that, and everyone has looked at the page once.
When the flux runs high the crucible hums, and some nights it whispers. An apprentice of mine answered once, to be polite. We do not use his room.
What did it say?
His name. Then ours, one at a time.
It is only the glass.
Of course it is. Put the lid on, and stand outside, and do not answer.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_blood_: My father kept one eye on the sky every night and the other on your kind. No offence meant.
Good. He would have said that was how it started, too.
Tall, quick, built for a long war. We have a name for it we do not say in the house.
Strange. When you came in, I heard my grandmother's old word for the sky, the one she sang when the lights were over the hills. "Home." She never said whose.
I never asked. I think she was afraid I would say it back.
Aye. The cold ones last longest.
retaking.jaymoskingdoms.road.arcana.forb: Ask a court wizard why Death and Blood are forbidden.
retaking.jaymoskingdoms.road.arcana.whis: Hear what a court wizard's crucible whispers when the flux runs high.
retaking.jaymoskingdoms.road.faith.argue: Let one of the Truth's clerics argue with you.
lore.jaymoskingdoms.the_wardens_second_p: The second night. I will not write what the wall looked like by morning. I will write that the water ran dark under the ford, and that the horses would not go near it, ours or theirs.
The old one with the beard held up his hand and it was noon for a breath. I saw the faces of the ones who were not alive. I would rather I had not.
The woman stood in the gate. They went round her, and over her, and not once through. I began to think the gate was something she was, and not something she was standing in.
The first night is on the other side of the sheet, if you want it. I do not think you do.
lore.jaymoskingdoms.the_wardens_last_pag: Written below the warden's, in a newer ink.
They came up out of the ground at the ford again, the way he said they might. Fewer than the first time. Enough.
We held it three nights. I could not tell you who stood beside me on the third. I could tell you where each of them stood.
The names are on the gatehouse wall, under his. There was room this time. I am told there will not always be.
